comment: The ansible-core lines of the render oracle. 'primary' versions define expected/common (identical on all primary versions) and expected/<label>; 'extra' versions (spike S-R1) are stored as sparse overlays: expected/<label>/<file> or a '<label>' key only where they differ from common/'both'. Docker images are built by build_images.sh (network only while building) and always run with --network none.
